plotSections.title: Choosing the Next Destination
bullets: The party needs to track down the lich and considers investigating the lich's former hideout in The Reach for clues rather than returning to Nyx and interrogating hobgoblins.
The party discusses using their keystones and Walker's portal-opening ability to reach The Reach, but the Gate spell's maximum 20-foot diameter is too small to bring their boat through.
The party has another potential way to reach The Reach through a captain who regularly travels between realms, and they also have their own boat available.
The party has enough food and water aboard the boat, and there is a centrally located port city in The Reach where they could potentially resupply.

plotSections.title: The Party's Crew and Elrus
bullets: The party confirms that their four surviving-and-revived crew members are Abel, Garrett, Bill, and Fritz. Dana remembers Garrett as the gunner and Abel as the helmsman; Fritz and Bill's exact roles remain unclear, although one is apparently a greenhorn.
Walker needs to take Elrus somewhere before the party leaves because he promised the very old man a place to stay. Instead, Walker discusses bringing Elrus along if the party returns to The Reach.
Elrus was already accompanying Walker because Walker had previously asked him to come along.

plotSections.title: Grixto, Galixtar, and the Training Grounds
bullets: The party's possible trip to The Reach is also connected to the plan to hunt down Grixto and Galixtar and finally defeat them.
Walker believes the plan was prompted by a previous vision showing Grixto and Galixtar in caves near the training grounds.

The caves associated with the dragons are likely to have been uninhabited for a long time, making it uncertain whether Grixto is still there. Walker's own former roost in The Reach is likewise described as effectively empty.

The party considers sending Walker and Elrus ahead as a scouting team, but Walker warns that if they encounter Grixto, Elrus may not hold back and a fight could result. Sylan ultimately becomes skeptical that a scouting trip is worthwhile unless the whole party goes.

plotSections.title: Al Kurin
bullets: Sylan asks about the Al Kurin seen in the previous vision. The DM explains that Grixto had been collecting Al Kurin from the other trainees, including juvenile dragons.
An Al Kurin is an object or vessel capable of being transported and contains the soul of a dragon, allowing the dragon's soul to be carried elsewhere.
The training grounds are within a couple of days' flight of the area where Walker had been staying, making Sylan question how Grixto could have remained hidden there while Walker was present.

chronologicalEvents: The party discusses whether to return to Langdale or pursue the lich in The Reach, settling on investigating the lich's former hideout for clues rather than immediately returning to Nyx.
Walker asks whether his portal can accommodate the party's boat; the DM clarifies that Gate creates a hole up to 20 feet in diameter, so the boat cannot pass through.
The party considers alternative transportation to The Reach, including their boat and a captain known to travel between realms.
The party confirms that their four crew members are Abel, Garrett, Bill, and Fritz, and Dana recalls that Garrett is the gunner and Abel is the helmsman.
Walker realizes he must address his promise to provide Elrus with a place to stay and asks whether Elrus would accompany the party back to The Reach.
The party discusses hunting Grixto and Galixtar in The Reach based on a previous vision of them near caves by the training grounds.
The party considers scouting the area with Walker and Elrus rather than taking everyone, but Walker warns that an encounter with Grixto would likely become a fight.
Sylan asks Elrus about the Al Kurin from the vision and learns that Grixto had been collecting these dragon-soul vessels from trainees, including juvenile dragons.

After learning the training grounds are only a couple of days' flight from Walker's former location, Sylan concludes that Grixto is unlikely to still be hiding there unless the whole party investigates.
